site.title: Nextcloud Self-Hosted Cloud Guide
site.subtitle: Keep your files at home
site.description: A 22-chapter Nextcloud tutorial with 3 appendices: install, login, file management and sharing, then Photos, Calendar, Talk, desktop and mobile sync, admin settings, security and troubleshooting.
site.footerMeta: Screenshots are of the official Nextcloud interface. Nextcloud is a trademark of its respective owner; this site is not affiliated with it.
